stations.title: Theo
stations.say: No red, but the numbers are odd.
stations.note: He runs the till at closing.

stations.title: Till file
stations.text: Runs to the end and prints wrong answers.

stations.title: Day's totals
stations.text: Numbers Theo can trust at closing.

captions: Closing time at Wickhollow Candles. Theo asks why the day's numbers look odd.
The till runs with no error at all, and still prints answers nobody believes.
You find and fix the three lines that make wrong values.
Now the total, the candles packed and the label length all add up.
No error is not the same as right. The laptop works again, and Theo has his numbers.
